details.description: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct is Alibaba's Qwen team's dense vision-language model, listed at roughly 32-33 billion parameters on its Hugging Face model card. It is the standard instruction-following edition of the 32B size, released October 21, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license, alongside a separate reasoning-enhanced 'Thinking' edition of the same size, per the Qwen3-VL GitHub README. The model card documents a native 256,000-token context window, expandable to 1 million tokens via YaRN, and covers image, video and text understanding with Interleaved-MRoPE positional embeddings and DeepStack multi-level Vision Transformer feature fusion, plus OCR support across 32 languages and visual-agent GUI operation.
advantages: Supports OCR in 32 languages, up from 19 in the prior Qwen-VL generation, with improved handling of rare or ancient characters (Qwen model card).
Documented visual agent capability: recognizes on-screen elements and invokes tools to operate PC and mobile GUIs (Qwen model card).
Can generate Draw.io, HTML, CSS and JS code directly from images or videos of interfaces or diagrams (Qwen model card).
Includes 2D and 3D spatial grounding for visual reasoning and embodied-AI tasks (Qwen model card).
Native 256,000-token context window per the model card, expandable to 1 million tokens via YaRN.
disadvantages: Qwen also offers a separate 'Thinking' edition of the 32B size with reasoning-enhanced performance; this Instruct edition is the standard, non-reasoning variant (Qwen3-VL GitHub README).
The maker's benchmark tables for this model are published only as images, so no independently verifiable numeric benchmark scores could be confirmed from the pages opened.
use_cases: Visual agent workflows that operate GUIs by recognizing on-screen elements and invoking tools
Converting screenshots, mockups or diagrams into Draw.io, HTML, CSS or JS code
Document and OCR understanding across many languages
General multimodal question answering over images and video

notes: Catalog facts list max input/output tokens as 4,096 for this route, but the maker's model card and GitHub README both state a native 256,000-token context window (expandable to 1 million); kept the catalog's values per instructions and flag the discrepancy here. Catalog also lists this route's modality as text-only, though Qwen documents Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct as a vision-language model that accepts image and video input. Benchmark tables on the model card are images, so no numeric evaluation scores could be verified from the pages opened. Fireworks' own listing for this model shows tool/function calling as not supported there, which is a host-serving detail rather than a claim about the model itself, so it was left out of the description.
